##### Project general facts

A manifestation of luxurious living, blending the heritage
of captivating equestrian experiences with seamless landscapes exuding modernity. A lifestyle that offers an opportunity to be one with nature, every day. Grand Polo Club & Resort is a masterplan which is built to strike fine balance between lifestyle principles of leisure, nature, connectivity, wellness and recreation.

An architecture concept that is less disruptive to the surroundings and crafted with moments of iconic landmarks. It is accentuated further by using clean lines, gentle and almost silent gestures. And enhanced by playing with shade and shadows as fundamental element. Whilst having the equestrian prestige at its heart, the green spaces loop-around and branch-out across the masterplan, connecting the residences thereby fostering a sense of community and belonging.

The design inspiration is invariably applied to the residences of Grand Polo Club & Resort. These exclusive homes are crafted with high emphasis on clean horizontal and vertical lines to exude grandeur and expansiveness. The interiors of these residences is a celebration of refined elegance, where the cool, polished stone floors reflect both light and luxury, creating a seamless connection with the natural beauty of the surrounding polo fields. Soft, muted tones and rich textures evoke a sense of tranquility and adds a touch of dramatic sophistication. The space envelops you in a sense of timelessness, capturing the spirit of the polo fields with a serene yet opulent atmosphere.

##### Location description and benefits

Explore the refined elegance of the Grand Polo Club and Resort by Emaar, a sophisticated sanctuary located within Dubai Investment Park 2. This development is not just a residential area but a lifestyle destination that harmoniously combines luxury with sustainability. Surrounded by expansive green spaces and pristine polo fields, the resort is a haven for equestrian enthusiasts and lovers of tranquil living.

Its strategic location offers seamless access to key points across Dubai, ensuring both convenience and connectivity. The architectural design and community planning reflect a commitment to comfort and aesthetic excellence, integrating modern amenities within a serene environment. Residents enjoy a blend of upscale living and natural beauty, where every detail is curated to support a holistic lifestyle—from leisurely rides on dedicated trails to moments of relaxation in beautifully landscaped parks.

Crafted with eco-conscious principles, the community incorporates energy-efficient solutions and sustainable materials, highlighting Emaar’s dedication to environmental responsibility. Whether choosing a luxurious villa or a stylish townhouse, homeowners at the Grand Polo Club and Resort experience a unique fusion of elegance, functionality, and forward-thinking design.
